correctness.rationale: For each N>=3 the two overlapping directed cycles imply det(tI-K)=t^N-t-1. The chosen cylinder mass rationally recovers the Perron root; Selmer irreducibility gives degree N. Finite matrix exponential scaling gives generator rho(Q-I). A standalone script passed 54 exact determinant samples and 58 dimension tests, supplementary to the analytical proof.
